IN THE उच्च न्यायालय OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD

CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION NO. 14205 OF 2023

Vikram Singh ... आवेदक / अभियुक्त Versus State of Uttar Pradesh ... प्रत्यर्थी / शिकायतकर्ता

CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR

ORDER:

1. आवेदक के विद्वान अधिवक्ता श्री Ramesh Chandra तथा State of Uttar Pradesh के विद्वान अपर शासकीय अधिवक्ता श्री A.K. Sharma को सुना गया।

2. This is an application under धारा 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of नियमित जमानत to the आवेदक in Case Crime No. 342 of 2023 under धाराएं 420, 467, 468, and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station Gomti Nagar, Lucknow.

3. विद्वान अधिवक्ता for the आवेदक submits that the आवेदक is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to business rivalry. It is submitted that the dispute is essentially of a civil nature and no प्रथम दृष्टया case is made out against the आवेदक. The आवेदक has been languishing in jail since 12th August, 2023.

4. Learned Additional Government Advocate vehemently opposed the जमानत याचिका, contending that there are serious allegations of financial fraud involving ₹45,00,000/- (Rupees Forty Five Lakhs only) against the आवेदक. (Rs. 45,00,000/-)

5. Having heard the parties and perused the record, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court finds that the charge-sheet has already been submitted and the trial is likely to take considerable time.

6. आवेदक Vikram Singh को विद्वान मुख्य न्यायिक मजिस्ट्रेट, Lucknow की संतुष्टि के अनुरूप समान राशि के दो विश्वसनीय प्रतिभुओं के साथ ₹1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) की राशि का व्यक्तिगत बंधपत्र प्रस्तुत करने पर निम्नलिखित शर्तों के अधीन जमानत पर रिहा किया जाए: (Rs. 1,00,000/-)

(i) The आवेदक नहीं करेगा tamper with the prosecution witnesses or intimidate any person acquainted with the facts of the case.

(ii) The आवेदक करेगा cooperate with the trial and करेगा attend the Learned Trial Court on each date fixed unless exempted.

(iii) The आवेदक नहीं करेगा leave the territory of India without prior permission of the Trial Court.

7. उपरोक्त शर्तों में से किसी के भी उल्लंघन की स्थिति में, विद्वान विचारण न्यायालय को कानून के अनुसार जमानत रद्द करने की स्वतंत्रता होगी।

8. तदनुसार जमानत याचिका स्वीकार की जाती है।
